scope: Only the approved zero-wait TX/GPIO wrapper. No RX, FIFO, interrupt, bus fabric, CPU, SoC, formal timing or hardware.

secondary.note: Minimal normal send, repeat and reset recovery only.

not_run.reason: No new full matrix; N16 primary and N234 minimal cover approved scope. N8 retained as prior core evidence.

manual_expectations.W01: rst_n=0: io_rdata=0, gpio_out=0, uart_tx=1, io_wr_error=0. Release edge with a write request must not accept (pre-edge ready=0); that edge is one real request and must be counted as rejected by the public request monitor. A following legal edge accepts exactly once.
manual_expectations.W02: io_sel=0 or io_wr_en=0: all writes rejected/no effect. Reads 0x00/0x08/0x0c/0x10 return 0/tx_ready/gpio_out/gpio_in_sync; unselected or nonaligned reads return 0; reads never change counters/state.
manual_expectations.W03: Three consecutive GPIO writes A,A,B on E edges produce three independent write events, no dedup; the actual GPIO accept ledger must show A,A,B, including two separate A writes. High 24 wdata bits ignored.
manual_expectations.W04: GPIO input is not fed to output. A stable change before E0 reaches sync_meta at E0 and gpio_in_sync at E1; wrapper adds no extra synchronizer. Check x/z on relevant outputs.
manual_expectations.W05: Aligned full-strobe write 0x00 with tx_ready=1 starts one 8N1 frame at E; independent serial decoder sees start low, 8 LSB-first data bits and stop high; high wdata bits ignored. No extra frame.
manual_expectations.W06: Write 0x00 while tx_busy=1: io_wr_error=1, tx_valid not asserted, no queued frame. At the ready-return edge pre-edge ready=0: reject. Following eligible edge accepts exactly one. Same byte repeated still creates independent frames.
manual_expectations.W07: Writes to 04/14, 08, 10, unselected, nonaligned, io_wstrb!=1111 all set io_wr_error and cause no TX/GPIO side effect. Read-only/reserved reads return 0.
manual_expectations.W08: Every valid E edge is one request; no edge detection/dedup. Request count/order, success/reject flags and side effects match the frozen table; no hidden extra writes.
manual_expectations.W09: Reset during TX start/data/stop cancels the frame (no completion); gpio_out and gpio_in_sync clear; after release a new TX write/GPIO write succeeds once, old request is not replayed.
manual_expectations.W10: Control checker passes correct expected TX byte/GPIO sequence. Deliberately wrong byte, missing frame, extra frame, extra/missing/duplicate GPIO acceptance, missing/duplicate/wrong TEST marker, TEST_FAIL, nonzero native rc and truncated log must be detected; ordinary process timeout is not success.

write_gate: request = rst_n && io_sel && io_wr_en; success = aligned && strobe=1111 && ((addr=00 && tx_ready) || addr=0c); otherwise io_wr_error=1 and no core side effect.

limits.runner: shared bounded runner after P0-1/P0-2 corrections

expected_counts.note: W01 first-release request is a real rejected request (pre-edge ready=0) and must be counted by the public request monitor. W06/W07 rejects and W09 cancellations are separate from completed frames. A,A and 11,11 are independent GPIO accepts.

result_rules.PASS: native rc=0, no timeout, no truncated log, all expected markers/counts and checker control
result_rules.TIMEOUT: only deliberate watchdog case; a normal case timeout is FAIL

limitations: No RX, FIFO, interrupt, bus fabric, CPU or SoC integration.
N8 is not rerun in this package; prior core evidence remains separate.
N234 is a reduced normal/repeat/reset smoke, not a full W01-W10 matrix.
The 1.0.1 plan is functionally identical to 1.0.0; it only records ordinary VCD generation. The earlier 1.0.0 run remains available as history, not as a final VCD-bearing acceptance run.
The 1.0.2 plan corrects the W01 request accounting from 10 to 11 rejects and freezes the actual event ledger; it does not change the wrapper RTL or frozen TX/GPIO cores.
W06 ready-return-edge request coverage is explicitly marked as a gap; no claim is made for it.
W06 is covered by A-W06-SUPPLEMENT in the mainline reply; B's 1.0.4 retains the old gap as history and does not rerun W06.
1.0.5 changes only TX monitor event/observed edge labels; TX/wrapper RTL and timing unchanged. W06 remains A-W06-SUPPLEMENT.

evidence.note: 1.0.3 freezes independent uart_tx capture, one-based seq/edge, request fields, and capture selfcheck. It preserves 1.0.2 functional counts and all old plans.

entry_markers.rule: Each expected TEST_BEGIN/TEST_PASS appears exactly once, in order, with no extra marker; one global REGIF_M1_SELFCHECK_PASS; missing/duplicate/wrong marker, TEST_FAIL/CHK_FAIL, nonzero native rc or truncated log => FAIL.

event_ledger.source: Public REGIF_REQ/TX_FRAME/GPIO_ACCEPT logs; TX COMPLETE/CANCEL comes from the shared public uart_tx serial monitor, not tx_ready or last_tx_byte. Request fields are frozen in request_fields.

request_fields.rule: seq consecutive 1..N; edge first anchor 9/6 and strictly increasing/unique; address/strobe/error/ready/accept kind match the manually frozen sequence; no DUT-derived edge table.

capture_selfcheck.note: Synthetic public uart_tx only; same monitor module as formal N16/N234.

coverage_gaps: W06: a write request exactly on the ready-return edge is not separately exercised; the busy write covers pre-edge ready=0 rejection. This is explicitly marked, not claimed as ready-return-edge coverage.

expected_request_edges.note: Frozen request timeline from the fixed test schedule; analyzer rejects nonfirst edge mutations, not just first edge.

tx_event_rules.event_edge: true accept/start edge E or true E+10N end edge.
tx_event_rules.observed_edge: next posedge where the independent public-pin monitor sampled the transition; observed_edge = event_edge + 1.
tx_event_rules.start: START event_edge equals the accepted request edge.
tx_event_rules.complete: COMPLETE event_edge = START event_edge + 10N; observed_edge = event_edge + 1.
tx_event_rules.cancel: reset before E+10N is CANCEL; event_edge and observed_edge are logged separately.
tx_event_rules.last_half_stop: synthetic shared-monitor reset in the last half of the stop bit must CANCEL.

R2_acceptance.mutation: COMPLETE observed edge 999999 or event edge not E+10N rejected.
